title: Параллельные формы в точном отчёте
description: Параллельные формы в точном отчёте: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Не расширять содержание при грамматической правке
notes: The role involves checking, recording and reporting: однородные элементы имеют одинаковую форму.
Исправляя форму, сохраняй исходные действия; редактура не добавляет новых обязанностей.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

public_payload.passage: An editor revised a volunteer role description that listed checking dates, to record changes, and reporting discrepancies. She made the three forms parallel, using checking, recording, and reporting. During review, another colleague suggested adding approval of expenditure because it sounded like a natural final responsibility. The editor declined: grammatical consistency did not authorise a wider role. Approval belonged to a different team and had never appeared in the source description. The final version was easier to read while preserving the original scope. Its improvement lay in the relationship between the listed forms, not in a new claim about the volunteer’s authority or the range of decisions they could make.

options.label: She added authority to approve expenditure.
She made the existing actions grammatically parallel.

exercises.editorial_answer: She made the existing actions grammatically parallel.
exercises.explanation: Редактор согласовала формы, сохранив исходные действия.
